question: The apparent position of a star keeps on changing slightly because:

options.text: the physical conditions of the atmosphere keep changing
the atmosphere consists of a mixture of gases
the physical conditions of the atmosphere are stationary

solution:
The correct answer is '**the physical conditions of the atmosphere keep changing**'.
